binding: Same development cases, arithmetic contracts, held cases, condition framing, local model configuration and 600-token per-arm rule as the initial compact comparison.
cause: The initial direct and named arms stopped after 31 tokens and copied literal outputs from a worked example. The HARNESS arm stopped after 29 tokens and failed the expression grammar.
intervention: One shared diagnostic instruction on using variable expressions and treating expected outputs as examples. No decisive formula supplied, no confirmation was opened, exactly one new dispatch per arm.
